newsitem.title: USA: Three deer invade White House complex.
newsitem.headline: Three deer invade White House complex.

text.p: Three deer, all does, wandered into the White House complex on Friday and ran into an urban nightmare.
One got stuck in the fence protecting the east grounds of the White House and injured itself trying to wriggle free. U.S. Park Police officials said it was tranquillised and later killed.
A second deer bounded over a small fence around the Treasury Department building. It was tranquillised and destroyed.
The third wandered across Pennsylvania Avenue and into the courtyard of the New Executive Office Building where some White House officials work. Authorities captured it.
Park Police spokesman Maj. Robert Heines said the deer probably strayed from nearby Rock Creek Park in a search for food.
Deer are often seen in Washington's leafy suburbs.
